Which solution should the solutions architect recommend to satisfy the requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: B
options.text: Deploy a custom management layer on self-managed virtual machines to coordinate all environments and manually approve every infrastructure change.

options.label: C
options.text: Separate production and non-production boundaries while integrating CloudWatch to improve resilience, observability, and controlled delegation.

options.label: D
